config.maphud.visibleInAllPerspectives.d: Should the map HUD be visible in all perspectives or only in third person
config.maphud.selectSlotKey.desc: Toggles the selected map. Toggled maps will remain visible as long as the map stays in your inventory. To toggle a map either hold the map in your hand or hover over the slot in your inventory, and press the keybind
config.maphud.renderMapBackground.desc: Should the map background texture be rendered
